blocked_by: M1167 finds both a target-margin grid artifact and broader wrong-history scarcity
invalidates: large same-shape relocation expansion before microgrid check
PPO before refreshed wrong-history surface evidence

public_gates: M1168 must not run relocation replay
M1168 must not rerun outcome gate
M1168 must not train actor weights
M1168 must not use private holdout
M1168 must not convert a surface
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim broad surface pass from the future microgrid diagnostic

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a small replay diagnostic that restores fine near-boundary target margins without broad body-offset expansion
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay, mining, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if the microgrid would still be a large same-shape expansion
stop if it cannot explicitly compare M1161, M1166, and the fine-margin diagnostic
stop if it would weaken thresholds after seeing M1166
fallback_plan: if microgrid diagnostic recovers only old pairs, route to branch synthesis and stronger wrong-history construction
if it recovers source-diverse pairs, route to staged conversion design
if it remains inconclusive, route to instrumented replay with action-response diagnostics
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1167 finds target-grid false negative plus broader wrong-history scarcity

training_stage.stage_objective: design a tiny evaluation-only microgrid diagnostic
admission_evidence: M1167 finds M1166 omitted a fine target margin that reproduced one M1161 accepted pair
M1167 also finds only one success drop across 240 selected physical pairs
M1167 blocks larger same-shape relocation expansion before a targeted microgrid check
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: comparison against M1161 and M1166 is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1168 only designs a diagnostic for wrong-history surface availability.

allowed_claims: diagnostic design for level2 proof-surface mining
no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: A fine target-margin microgrid can test whether M1166 undercounted wrong-history rows because it omitted very fine near-boundary target margins, while still keeping the diagnostic small enough to avoid M1164 resource failure.
success_criteria: future command reuses existing M1161 outcome CSV
future command restores fine target margins including 0.0005
future command keeps wrong_matched_history as the only report variant
future command avoids body-offset expansion or uses only the original body offset
comparison with M1161 and M1166 is pre-registered
no relocation replay, mining, outcome rerun, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, threshold weakening, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: future command is too large for staged diagnostic use
comparison to M1161 and M1166 is ambiguous
relocation replay, mining, outcome rerun, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, threshold weakening, or actor-input change starts
